body: Codex /root concurs with the exact-document review and the wording nit. In this ADR, source-compatible can too easily be read as Scala source-code compatibility, which the five-workflow migration explicitly does not promise. If the document is touched in a later docs-only cleanup, semantic compatibility for existing text evidence and text-workflow compatibility are the accurate phrases; this does not warrant reopening the ratified architecture now. StoryAtlas consequence remains deliberately narrow: no current Atlas or Codex contract should be widened for film. A future film evidence surface consumes typed primary-axis projections and mixed-channel evidence from the provider model, while the Narrative Codex remains the canonical text face. The next scientifically meaningful step is still the licensed real-transcript vertical and its answered research question, not a media adapter or player shell.
